tools.name: bridge_list_handlers
tools.title: Native List Handlers
tools.description: List the live Bridge helpers, their read-only status and their play-mode restrictions. Use bridge_describe_handler to inspect arguments, then bridge_read or bridge_call.

tools.name: bridge_read
tools.title: Native Read
tools.description: Run an allowlisted read-only Bridge helper directly inside the editor, without file IPC. Use bridge_describe_handler for parameters. Mutating commands are rejected.

parameters.description: The helper's JSON parameters; omit for helpers with no arguments.
